errors.text_span: като стрелките показват желаното посочване на стойностите (напр. ↑ означава по-висока стойност е по-добре, ↓ – по-ниска)
errors.evidence: The description interprets the meaning of the arrows next to the metric names. The prompt explicitly forbids making interpretations.
For the metric CCP ↑, the value for the RPG (CodeLlama-34B) bar is approximately 0.95, not 0.9.

errors.text_span: Някои стълби са визуално подчертани чрез по-тъмно очертаване или по-светъл фон
errors.evidence: The chart does not contain any visual emphasis such as darker outlines or lighter backgrounds on specific bars. The bars all have the same standard styling.
The color used for RPG (CodeLlama-7B) is orange, not yellow.
The color used for RPG (CodeLlama-34B) is a dark orange or burnt orange, not brown.
For the metric CCP ↑, the value for RPG (7B) is visibly higher than for Greedy (34B). Approximating both as 0.7 loses this distinction. The values are closer to 0.72 and 0.70 respectively.

errors.text_span: For EGP ↑, RPG (CodeLlama-7B) achieves the highest performance (~0.9), followed by RPG (CodeLlama-34B) at ~0.95
errors.evidence: This incorrectly ranks the performance for the EGP metric. The chart clearly shows the dark orange bar for RPG (CodeLlama-34B) is the tallest in the group (at approx. 0.98), while the gold bar for RPG (CodeLlama-7B) is shorter (at approx. 0.89).

The prompt instructs to avoid interpretation such as 'performs best'. Furthermore, for the TR-N ↓ metric, a lower value indicates better performance. The description incorrectly identifies the bar with the highest value (Greedy 7B at ~0.7) as the 'best', when the bar with the lowest value (RPG 34B at ~0.4) would represent the best performance.

errors.text_span: The chart shows that RPG generally outperforms Greedy on EGP and CCP, while Greedy performs better on TR-N and TR-S, with larger models (34B) showing higher performance in RPG-based methods.
errors.evidence: This entire sentence is a summary and conclusion drawn from the data, which is explicitly forbidden by the prompt's instruction to 'Avoid making inferences, comparisons, or drawing conclusions about the data.'

errors.text_span: with arrows indicating the direction of preference (↑ for higher is better, ↓ for lower is better)
errors.evidence: The prompt asks to describe visual and labeled characteristics only, and to avoid interpretation. Explaining what the arrows mean ('higher is better') is an interpretation of the symbols rather than a direct description of the label itself.
